claims.claim_text: At approximately 1345 hours, I received a dispatch call regarding a domestic disturbance involving an armed individual near a school bus.
I was assigned as the primary responding unit and departed from the station within ninety seconds of receiving the call, arriving in the vicinity of the pursuit approximately three minutes later.
The subject had displayed a firearm near a school bus.
I observed the subject's grey Chevrolet Tahoe traveling southbound on Western Avenue, pursued by a single marked patrol unit.
From the time I took the lead, the pursuit continued for approximately two minutes before the subject entered the school district parking lot.
The subject drove through an open gate into the Buena Park Unified School District Office parking lot.
The subject's vehicle struck a parked vehicle at moderate speed, causing minor displacement of approximately two feet.
The subject immediately exited his vehicle and began walking eastbound across the parking lot. I did not observe a weapon in the subject's hands as he exited.
I discharged my firearm eight times.
Officer Langston discharged his firearm twelve times from a position approximately forty yards to my left.
The subject continued advancing for approximately twenty seconds before collapsing.
We approached the subject within approximately two minutes, secured the weapon, and applied handcuffs.
Orange County Fire Authority paramedics arrived approximately eight minutes later at 1418 hours.
The subject was pronounced deceased on scene at approximately 1430 hours.
Twenty (20) cartridge cases recovered from scene.
